title: HubSummary
description: One hub's contribution to content resilience. Hub is a *role* (dial-up-by-capability), not a notarized entity — substrate stays kind-agnostic; kind classification (dwelling/collective/computed) happens at the projection layer. Source of truth: peer_blob_inventory (gossip operational) + peer-identity bindings (Category-A DHT) + hub-membership facts where notarized. Operational Category C — no DHT entry.

hubId.description: Stable identifier for this hub. When hub-membership facts are not yet notarized, hubId is the peer_id of the single-device participant (Computed kind). Future: dwelling_id or collective_id when binding tables distinguish.

kind.description: Hub kind. dwelling = single household; collective = qahal-scoped hub; computed = ad-hoc or single-device participation. New kinds slot in here without changing API shape.

replicaCount.description: Number of blob inventory entries this hub holds for the content.

lastVerifiedSeconds.description: Seconds since the most recent inventory record for this hub, or null when last_seen_at is unavailable.

displayLabel.description: Optional human-readable label for UI display. Absent when no label is known.
